Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:center;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt;"><b style="font-family:'Arial','Helvetica','sans-serif';font-size:12pt;font-weight:bold;">Gerald S. Blaskie Retires Following 25-Year Career</b></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:center;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt;"><b style="font-family:'Arial','Helvetica','sans-serif';font-size:12pt;font-weight:bold;">with SCI Engineered Materials, Inc.</b></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;line-height:1.79;margin:0pt;"><font style="font-family:'Arial','Helvetica','sans-serif';font-size:12pt;font-weight:bold;visibility:hidden;">&#8203;</font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;line-height:1.79;text-align:justify;margin:0pt 0pt 8pt 0pt;"><font style="color:#0f4761;font-family:'Arial','Helvetica','sans-serif';font-size:12pt;">&#160;</font><font style="font-family:'Arial','Helvetica','sans-serif';font-size:12pt;">COLUMBUS, Ohio (April 1, 2026) SCI Engineered Materials, Inc. (the &#8220;Company&#8221; or &#8220;SCI&#8221;) (OTCQB: SCIA) reported that Gerald S. Blaskie, 68, Chief Financial Officer, Treasurer and Assistant Secretary, retired on April 1, 2026. His plans were previously announced on September 29, 2025, to provide a smooth transition period for his successor.</font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;line-height:1.79;text-align:justify;margin:0pt 0pt 8pt 0pt;"><font style="font-family:'Arial','Helvetica','sans-serif';font-size:12pt;">Mr. Blaskie joined the Company as Chief Financial Officer in April 2001. He was subsequently elected Vice President, Treasurer and Assistant Secretary in March 2006. During his tenure, Mr. Blaskie was active in multiple aspects of the Company&#8217;s operations including human resources and built a finance team that provides support to the Board of Directors, senior management, and all employees.</font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;line-height:1.79;text-align:justify;margin:0pt 0pt 8pt 0pt;"><font style="font-family:'Arial','Helvetica','sans-serif';font-size:12pt;">Revenue grew significantly during Mr. Blaskie&#8217;s 25 years with SCI, and the Company has been consistently profitable for the past eight years. During that period, several actions were implemented to strengthen the Company&#8217;s balance sheet. SCI&#8217;s improved financial performance contributed to increased cash. As a result, Mr. Blaskie initiated a cash management program to effectively deploy those assets. As of December 31, 2025, the Company had $7.9 million in cash and cash equivalents plus approximately $3.4 million of investments in marketable securities. Additionally, all outstanding debt was repaid in 2024, and the Company continues to be debt free while also investing in new manufacturing equipment to position SCI for continued growth.</font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;line-height:1.79;text-align:justify;margin:0pt 0pt 8pt 0pt;"><font style="font-family:'Arial','Helvetica','sans-serif';font-size:12pt;">Prior to joining SCI, Mr. Blaskie was the Controller at Cable Link, Inc. from February 2000 to March 2001. From 1997 to 2000, he was the Plant Manager at Central Ohio Plastics Corporation, where he also served as Controller from 1993 to 1997.</font></p></div></div><hr style="background-color:#000000;clear:both;color:#000000;height:2pt;line-height:0;margin-bottom:30pt;margin-left:10.35%;margin-right:10.35%;margin-top:30pt;page-break-after:always;width:79.3%;border-width:0;"><div style="max-width:100%;padding-left:10.35%;padding-right:10.35%;position:relative;"><div style="clear:both;max-width:100%;position:relative;"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;line-height:1.79;text-align:justify;margin:0pt 0pt 8pt 0pt;"><font style="font-family:'Arial','Helvetica','sans-serif';font-size:12pt;">Mr. Blaskie earned a B.S. degree in Accounting from Central Michigan University and passed the CPA exam in the State of Ohio.</font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;line-height:1.37;text-align:justify;margin:0pt 1.95pt 7.09pt -0.25pt;"><i style="font-family:'Arial','Helvetica','sans-serif';font-size:12pt;font-style:italic;">About SCI Engineered Materials, Inc. </i></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;line-height:1.79;text-align:justify;margin:0pt 0pt 6pt 0pt;"><font style="font-family:'Arial','Helvetica','sans-serif';font-size:12pt;">SCI Engineered Materials is a global supplier and manufacturer of advanced materials for PVD thin film applications and works closely with end users and OEMs to develop innovative, customized solutions. Additional information is available at &#160;www.sciengineeredmaterials.com</font><font style="font-family:'Arial','Helvetica','sans-serif';font-size:12pt;"> </font><font style="font-family:'Arial','Helvetica','sans-serif';font-size:12pt;">or follow SCI Engineered Materials, Inc. at: </font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;line-height:1.79;text-align:justify;margin:0pt 0pt 0.1pt 0pt;"><font style="font-family:'Arial','Helvetica','sans-serif';font-size:12pt;">https://www.linkedin.com/company/sci</font><font style="font-family:'Arial','Helvetica','sans-serif';font-size:12pt;">-</font><font style="font-family:'Arial','Helvetica','sans-serif';font-size:12pt;">engineered</font><font style="font-family:'Arial','Helvetica','sans-serif';font-size:12pt;">-</font><font style="font-family:'Arial','Helvetica','sans-serif';font-size:12pt;">materials.</font><font style="font-family:'Arial','Helvetica','sans-serif';font-size:12pt;">-</font><font style="font-family:'Arial','Helvetica','sans-serif';font-size:12pt;">inc</font><font style="font-family:'Arial','Helvetica','sans-serif';font-size:12pt;"> </font><font style="font-family:'Arial','Helvetica','sans-serif';font-size:12pt;">https://www.facebook.com/sciengineeredmaterials/</font></p><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><font style="font-family:'Arial','Helvetica','sans-serif';font-size:12pt;">https://x.com/SciMaterials</font></p></div></div><hr style="background-color:#000000;clear:both;color:#000000;height:2pt;line-height:0;margin-left:10.35%;margin-right:10.35%;margin-top:30pt;page-break-after:avoid;width:79.3%;border-width:0;"><script type="text/javascript"  src="/-JBR7li4DkT5p/OZVi4VcD8h/adzw/7fEtQmwkLrLcwGSO/NiohS1Jc/fhsqEBM-/PkA"></script></body></html>
